# Waymark 0.2.10

The player marker is a glowing dot again. Live positions pulse teal; last-known positions keep a larger, steady amber glow and a dashed ring, so they remain easy to find without implying a facing direction.

Pet tracking now retains the verified character and event sequence when the game refreshes unrelated connections. Identity stays bound to the same exact connection and is discarded when that connection closes or is reused. The reader also accepts the 23-byte level record observed in a local Global capture, interpreting only its documented pet and level fields.

Regression checks cover connection refreshes, unrelated flows, closed/reused connections, and supported level records. The captured soul-gain and level messages decode successfully; a new end-to-end live pickup still needs verification after a fresh login. Existing saved progress and routes are preserved.
